Tree concepts

Shapes (per wood type)

quarter — a mesh (.obj, facedir 0..3; inner corner = trunk axis at +x +z for 0), a quarter of a chamfered column. Outline from above, outwards from the axis in sixteenths: (16,0)→(16,7)→(7,16)→(0,16): a 7/16 half flat, a slant, a 7/16 half flat, so two pieces make one 14/16 face — an octagon column. Faces on the axis side are left out; caps take *_tree_top, sides the bark with the grain up the trunk. Four make a 2×2, they round the corners of a 3×3 (edges and centre are logs). Collision/selection: the full cube.

base — connected node box, 12/16 thick: core {-6,-6,-6,6,6,6}, level arms reaching 8/16 into the neighbour, e.g. right {6,-6,-6,16,6,6}; top/bottom to the border. The first cell of a limb leaving a trunk: its arm meets the slanted face without a gap and, towards the branch, ends as a short sleeve (taper 16 → 12 → 10).

branch — connected node box, 10/16: core {-5,-5,-5,5,5,5}, arm right {5,-5,-5,8,5,5}.

twig — the same at 6/16: core {-3,-3,-3,3,3,3}, arm right {3,-3,-3,8,3,3}; the only piece that also joins leaves, and only a leaf above it (leaves get connect_sides = {"bottom"}), so twig ends reach up into their foliage. Base and twig also join the ground below them (ground nodes get connect_sides = {"top"}): roots.

Roots (thick apple and jungle now and then, kapok always): base on the ground beside the trunk, (branch,) twig diving in; placed only where the ground test passes — see the hillside in Shapes.

Logs (existing cubes) make 1×1 trunks and fill wide ones. Base, branch, twig and log take facedir only for the bark: param2 0 / 4 / 12 = grain along y / z / x. Boxes in sixteenths: x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2.

Drag to orbit, right-drag to pan, wheel to zoom. Counts: wood = log + quarter + branch + twig; shape nodes = quarter + branch + twig. “today” = the current schematic (probabilistic nodes counted as present).
